description: This file defines the NoteResponse class used as a data transfer object (DTO) for representing notes in API responses, including properties like id, title, content, createdAt, and updatedAt.

classes.name: NoteResponse
classes.description: A DTO representing a note in API responses, including fields for ID, title, content, creation timestamp, and last update timestamp.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the note.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the note.

methods.name: getTitle
methods.description: Returns the title of the note.

methods.name: setTitle
methods.description: Sets the title of the note.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Returns the content of the note.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Sets the content of the note.

methods.name: getCreatedAt
methods.description: Returns the creation timestamp of the note.

methods.name: setCreatedAt
methods.description: Sets the creation timestamp of the note.

methods.name: getUpdatedAt
methods.description: Returns the last update timestamp of the note.

methods.name: setUpdatedAt
methods.description: Sets the last update timestamp of the note.
